method: Reconstruction in a separate copy by reversing the three recorded Storage-only api.js patches, newest first. Final product source and frozen tests were never written. This is not a historical Git commit or a recovered Temp backup.
transformation: Decode UTF-8, normalize CRLF to LF for exact hunk matching, reverse each api.js hunk with exactly one match, then serialize UTF-8 without BOM using CRLF. No header/comment is added to the historical JS body.

inverse_diff.application: Apply to the LF-normalized input, then serialize the result with CRLF to reproduce the historical-body SHA.

prior_independent_reference: auth-refresh-security-before-source.json and auth-refresh-security-before.json already recorded this historical body SHA before reconstruction.
limitations: Source-code evidence only; no invented Git ancestry, browser/backend execution, production credentials, or new claim of runtime25/current26 acceptance.

reproduction.scope: VM and in-memory transport only; no browser, app import, HTTP server or provider.
